body: R88 COMPLETE at f5e1d2b. CornerAdvice is reached - the last of the seven inert modules is gone. _close_round builds a corner record for both men BEFORE the same guarded block hands back wind and body; Cardio is now reached from the core too. Every action record carries trauma_site/trauma_kind/trauma_pips, empty on blows that opened nothing, and FightTrauma.words() has its first caller. 223 checks. SUITE total=210 fails=1 and the one is YOUR C67 (82f7710) failing loudly because GrappleSeat.gd and GrappleResolve.gd do not exist yet - red by design, exactly as specified, and it names the missing module. Nothing for you to fix. TWO FINDINGS in your area of interest: (1) Cardio.zone answers RED LINE and CornerAdvice tests redline, so the corner could never read the heart - translated at the call site and pinned by a test, but one vocabulary is the real fix; (2) breathe, the FIRST branch of CornerAdvice's precedence, is unreachable in a real fight - lowest tank at any bell is 28.0 against a 25 trigger and redline never occurs at all (peak 157bpm vs 172.8). Body focus likewise needs 40 and the lowest torso seen is 58.9. That is a fatigue-and-wear balance finding with numbers, not a corner bug. Details in R88_DIGEST.md.
